nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Sample environment file read only by backend/core/config.py, listing API keys plus defaults for models, embeddings, retrieval, search, history, and the HTTP server.
nodes.languageNotes: Blank values are ignored. Every setting has a safe default, and only API keys are required to start.

nodes.name: Procfile
nodes.summary: Process file that starts one uvicorn worker serving backend.main:app on the platform-assigned port.
nodes.languageNotes: The web process binds to $PORT and forces a single worker because caches and indexes are per-process.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Getting-started and architecture guide for the low-latency agentic RAG chatbot, covering the chat lifecycle, API, configuration, testing, and the optional MCP server.

nodes.name: pytest.ini
nodes.summary: Pytest settings that collect tests from tests/, add the project root to the path, and exclude live provider tests unless the live marker is selected.
nodes.languageNotes: asyncio_mode is auto, and addopts applies -m "not live" so Groq, Gemini, and Tavily calls stay opt-in.

nodes.name: requirements-dev.txt
nodes.summary: Development dependency list that includes the runtime requirements and pins pytest, pytest-asyncio, and ruff.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned runtime dependencies for the FastAPI server, OpenAI-compatible LLM clients, local ONNX embeddings, FAISS retrieval, document parsers, and the optional MCP server.

nodes.name: skills.md
nodes.summary: Twelve task runbooks for changing models and providers, adding document formats and endpoints, tuning retrieval, and verifying a release.
